Annotation Interface AssistedFactory

@Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(METHOD) public @interface AssistedFactory
Marks a factory-interface method the annotation processor implements. The method's parameters supply the recipe's Assisted parameters (matched by type and tag); the container resolves everything else per call.

Link resolution: with no members, the method's return type is the implementation class; with value(), the implementation is value() and the return type may be any supertype of it; with value() and method(), the recipe is the named assisted @Provides method declared by value().

When the recipe has a child-local scope, the method creates its product in the nearest injector of the chain that hosts that scope, which caches it: from then on, the product resolves by its key through that injector and its descendants, and a second call through the same injector fails.
